Inflation costs (if playing the Inflation challenge). 2. Multiply this total by the `discount_percent` from the discount vouchers. 3. [Round half down](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rounding#Rounding_half_down "wikipedia:Rounding") (for example, 8.5 is rounded to 8). 4. If the buy price after rounding is [**$0**](https://balatrowiki.org/w/Money "Money") or lower, set it to [**$1**](https://balatrowiki.org/w/Money "Money"). 5. Apply any remaining [special cases](https://balatrowiki.org/w/The_Shop#Special_cases) (such as Astronomer, the Rental Sticker, or the Coupon Tag). ### Calculating sell value \[ [edit](https://balatrowiki.org/w/The_Shop?section=11&veaction=edit "Edit section: Calculating sell value") \| [edit source](https://balatrowiki.org/w/The_Shop?action=edit§ion=11 "Edit section's source code: Calculating sell value")\] 1. Recalculate the item's total [buy cost](https://balatrowiki.org/w/The_Shop#Calculating_buy_cost) (applying any vouchers bought in-between, any special case that changes the buy cost, etc.). 2. Divide the total buy cost by 2. 3. [Floor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rounding#Rounding_down "wikipedia:Rounding") the result of the division (for example, 3.75 is rounded to 3). 4. If the sell value after flooring is [**$0**](https://balatrowiki.org/w/Money "Money") or lower, set it to [**$1**](https://balatrowiki.org/w/Money "Money"). 5. Add any additional sell value gained from Egg or Gift Card. ## Gallery \[ [edit](https://balatrowiki.org/w/The_Shop?section=12&veaction=edit "Edit section: Gallery") \| [edit source](https://balatrowiki.org/w/The_Shop?action=edit§ion=12 "Edit section's source code: Gallery")\] - [![A screenshot of the Shop, featuring Raised Fist and Hack on the two random slots, a Buffoon Pack and a Jumbo Celestial Pack on the two Booster Pack slots, and a Planet Merchant voucher on the voucher slot.](https://balatrowiki.org/images/thumb/Screenshot_in_shop.png/300px-Screenshot_in_shop.png?8c608)](https://balatrowiki.org/w/File:Screenshot_in_shop.png "A screenshot of the Shop, featuring Raised Fist and Hack on the two random slots, a Buffoon Pack and a Jumbo Celestial Pack on the two Booster Pack slots, and a Planet Merchant voucher on the voucher slot.") [History](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Jokers?action=history) - [Purge](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Jokers?action=purge) - [Talk (0)](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Talk:Jokers?action=edit&redlink=1) _For the Joker that gives +4 Mult, see [Joker](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Joker "Joker")._ **Jokers** are special cards at the core of _[Balatro](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Balatro "Balatro")'s_ gameplay. Instead of being included in [Decks](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Decks "Decks") and played alongside standard cards, Jokers are obtained through [the Shop](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/The_Shop "The Shop") and occasionally other means, and are held in the player's dedicated Joker slots until the player sells them or they are destroyed. Players usually start with five Joker slots, but can lose or gain slots in some circumstances. Jokers possess unique effects that can synergize, and a strong combination of Jokers is typically essential for the player to defeat [Blinds](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Blinds_and_Antes "Blinds and Antes") at higher Antes. As of update [1.0.1o-FULL](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Update_1.0.1o "Update 1.0.1o"), there are 150 total Jokers of varying rarities, with 105 unlocked from the start and 45 unlockable through specific conditions. ## Contents - [1Modifiers](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Jokers#Modifiers) - [2Rarities](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Jokers#Rarities) - [3Important Joker Terms](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Jokers#Important_Joker_Terms) - [4List of Jokers](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Jokers#List_of_Jokers) - [5Trivia](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Jokers#Trivia) - [6References](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Jokers#References) ## Modifiers\[\] [![Various editions displayed in the .](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/balatrogame/images/a/a3/Editions.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/180?cb=20240226160851)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/balatrogame/images/a/a3/Editions.png/revision/latest?cb=20240226160851) Various editions displayed in the [Collection](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Collection "Collection"). Jokers can be enhanced with one of four different [Editions](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Card_Modifiers "Card Modifiers"), resulting in higher shop costs but adding an additional effect: - Base (standard card) - Foil (**+50** **Chips**) - Holographic ( **+10 [Mult](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Mult "Mult")**) - Polychrome ( **X1.5 [Mult](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Mult "Mult")**) - Negative (+1 Joker slot) In higher [stakes](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Stakes "Stakes"), Jokers can also appear with Eternal, Perishable, and/or Rental [Stickers](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Stickers "Stickers"). ## Rarities\[\] Jokers have four different rarities, denoting how likely they are to appear in a given run: [Common](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Common_Jokers "Category:Common Jokers") (61 Jokers), [Uncommon](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Uncommon_Jokers "Category:Uncommon Jokers") (64 Jokers), [Rare](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Rare_Jokers "Category:Rare Jokers") (20 Jokers), and [Legendary](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Legendary_Jokers "Category:Legendary Jokers") (5 Jokers). In general, higher rarity Jokers can be more powerful, but when a Joker has no direct analogue of a lower rarity, it can be difficult to determine if it is "better". When generating Jokers at random, there is a 70% chance of generating a Common Joker, a 25% chance of generating an Uncommon Joker, and a 5% chance of generating a Rare Joker. A Legendary Joker can only appear from The Soul [Spectral Card](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Spectral_Cards "Spectral Cards"). ## Important Joker Terms\[\] Jokers have a number of key terms that are vital in understanding how they work. - **When Scored**: The effect triggers when a card is scored. If the card is played but not scored, either from not being part of the scored poker hand or from being debuffed by a Boss Blind, the effect will not trigger. - **Contains**: The hand has the referenced hand as a part of it. For example, a Three of a Kind "contains" a Pair, despite scoring as a Three of a Kind. A Four of a Kind played with five cards of the same suit "contains" a Flush, and will trigger Flush Joker effects. Refer to the hand information in-game for a more detailed breakdown on which hands contain others. Notably, a Four of a Kind is not considered to "contain" Two Pair. - **Is**: In contrast, "poker hand is a pair" means the whole hand is classified as a pair, and the cards played don't constitute a higher-ranked hand. - **When Blind is Selected:** The effect triggers when you select a Blind. It will not trigger if the Blind is skipped. - **In Deck**: The effect depends on the remaining cards in your deck, not including cards in hand, played or discarded. - **In Full Deck**: This counts some attribute of your complete deck, referencing all cards whether they were drawn, played, discarded, or are held in hand. - **Add**: Adds a playing card to your deck permanently. - **Destroy**: Remove the target card. If a Joker is destroyed, no money or bonuses are gained that selling it would give. - **Create**: Creates a certain type of card, be it a consumable or Joker. This action always requires room for the card in question to take up. - **Gains**: Adds a (usually) permanent effect to the target card. This is usually referring to the Joker with the effect, though not always, as seen with Hiker. - **Retrigger**: This Joker will score a card again under certain conditions outlined by the Joker. This extra score will activate all effects that take place when the card scores, including effects from other Jokers, enhancements, editions, seals (besides Red Seal), and chips from the card itself. - **Debuffed**: This Joker and its edition can no longer trigger. It retains its full sell value (and can still be used by Swashbuckler/Temperance/etc). It can still be targeted by random effects such as Madness or Wheel of Fortune, but not by the Crimson Heart boss blind. web.markdown:
For a Balatro beginner guide that actually helps, start with one reliable scoring engine: **a repeatable hand, a useful Joker,** then xMult before the late Boss Blinds. **The fix is not to play** better poker. **The fix is to make each** shop visit support the same plan.

## \[Guide\] Balatro beginner guide : Jokers, antes and shop choices for your first win: Quick answer

- Start with the direct answer for \[Guide\] Balatro beginner guide : Jokers, antes and shop choices for your first win.

## Quick FAQ

## Key points

- Balatro is developed by LocalThunk and published by Playstack.
- The official Steam page lists 150 Jokers, 15 decks, 22 Tarot cards, 11 Planet cards and 32 Vouchers.
- Balatro’s official site links to PC, Nintendo, PlayStation, Xbox and mobile storefronts.
- The article images come from the official Playstack press kit.

Balatro is available on PC, Nintendo, PlayStation, Xbox and mobile. Every run follows the same rhythm: beat Blinds, spend money in the shop, improve the deck and reach the final Ante. For more gaming coverage on jeu.video, you can also check [our articles](https://jeu.video/categories/articles), [gaming news](https://jeu.video/categories/actualite) and [the latest posts](https://jeu.video/dernieres-actualites.html).

![Balatro run showing a Royal Flush, remaining hands, discards and the Blind score target to read before spending a discard](https://www.playbalatro.com/press-kit/Screenshots/Balatro_screenshot_1.jpg)Always read the Blind, remaining hands and current hand value before burning discards.

## Balatro beginner guide: key takeaways

- Early on, play a hand you can repeat.
- Try to keep your money near 25 dollars once your score is stable.
- Your first purchase should be a Joker that scores often.
- Planet Cards are best when they upgrade your main hand.
- A strong run usually needs chips, +Mult and xMult in that order.
- Read every Boss Blind before starting the round.

## Pick a reliable hand before picking a build

New players often lose because they try to play proper poker. In Balatro, Flushes and Straights can be excellent. They also need more filtering, more discards and sometimes deck manipulation.

For a first win, start with a hand you can repeat. Pair, Two Pair, Three of a Kind and Full House are good early choices. Ask what you can play three times without running out of discards.

![Balatro poker hand level menu showing Straight, Flush, Full House and other hand values for choosing what to upgrade](https://www.playbalatro.com/press-kit/Screenshots/Hand%20Levels.png)The hand level screen shows which hands have already been upgraded by Planet Cards.

| Run state | Recommended hand | Why it works |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Few Jokers | Pair or Two Pair | Easy to find and cheap in discards. |
| Many matching ranks | Three of a Kind or Full House | Reliable score with good scaling. |
| Many cards of one suit | Flush | Strong if the deck already supports it. |
| Unmodified deck | Straight, carefully | Powerful, but fragile without support. |

## Balatro beginner Jokers: buy effects that score now

The safest rule is simple: buy effects that trigger often. A cheap Joker that adds chips or +Mult to most hands beats a flashy rare card that needs a narrow setup. Early in a run, your deck is not shaped enough for highly conditional effects.

Think in three jobs. Your first Joker should secure chips or base Mult. Your second should support the hand you repeat. Your third should ideally multiply the final Mult with xMult.

![Balatro Joker collection showing different scoring effects for building chips, Mult and xMult during a beginner run](https://www.playbalatro.com/press-kit/Screenshots/Jokers.png)Jokers drive the run: keep frequent triggers and sell cards that no longer help.

1. After the first Blind, buy a cheap Joker that improves scoring.
2. Avoid expensive rerolls until you own at least one useful Joker.
3. Do not let a weak Joker occupy a slot when a key purchase appears.
4. Replace early-game Jokers once they stop keeping pace with Blind targets.
5. Label your Jokers mentally: chips, +Mult, xMult, economy or deck control.

## Use the shop without destroying your economy

The shop is where Balatro runs are won. The common mistake is buying every tempting pack and entering the next round broke. Money also creates interest between rounds.

A simple rule works well. Before Ante 3, buy what makes you stronger right away. After Ante 3, protect your economy. Keeping roughly 25 dollars lets you earn interest and fund important choices.

![Balatro shop with Jokers, Voucher, Arcana Pack, prices and reroll button for choosing purchases without breaking the economy](https://www.playbalatro.com/press-kit/Screenshots/Balatro_ui_3840x2160_2.png)In the shop, check the price first, then ask whether it helps the next Blind.

| Purchase | Priority | Beginner decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Reliable Joker | Very high | Buy if it triggers often. |
| Planet Card | Medium to high | Buy for your main hand only. |
| Tarot | Medium | Useful to reshape key cards. |
| Voucher | Variable | Take it if it helps the whole run. |
| Reroll | Low early | Avoid if money is still tight. |

## Open packs only when they support the plan

Packs can make you want to pivot constantly. A winning run stays coherent. Celestial Packs are mainly for leveling a hand you already play.

Arcana Packs become strong when they reshape the deck in a useful direction. They can add cards of one suit, improve key cards or remove weak cards. Do not buy a Planet Card for a hand you only hope to play later.

![Balatro Celestial Pack showing Planet Cards used to upgrade a specific hand before a difficult Blind](https://www.playbalatro.com/press-kit/Screenshots/Celestial%20Pack.png)Planet Cards should strengthen the hand your build already uses.![Balatro Arcana Packs showing Tarot packs used to transform the deck and make a strategy more consistent](https://www.playbalatro.com/press-kit/Screenshots/Arcana%20Packs.png)Tarot Cards are best used to fix suits, ranks, enhanced cards or weak cards.

## Read Boss Blinds before committing

Every Boss Blind can punish a narrow strategy. If the boss debuffs one suit and your run depends on that suit, adapt before starting. This check takes seconds.

Before selecting the Blind, open run information and check the upcoming boss. Then decide whether the shop has a clear job. Sometimes the correct play is a weaker hand that avoids the penalty.

![Balatro Boss Blind The Arm requiring four cards or fewer, with Jokers and hand visible for adapting the plan before scoring](https://www.playbalatro.com/press-kit/Screenshots/Combo%201.png)Some bosses change how many cards you can safely play.![Balatro Boss Blind The Club debuffing club cards, with a hand and Jokers visible for checking whether the build is at risk](https://www.playbalatro.com/press-kit/Screenshots/Combo%202.png)A suit-debuffing boss punishes builds that depend too much on one suit.

## Balatro **beginner route** to the first win

For the first victory, play clean rather than flashy. Huge scores come later, once you have unlocked more tools and learned more patterns. Your goal in each Ante is simple: improve scoring, protect money or fix the deck.

- Antes 1-2: find a scoring Joker and play simple hands.
- Ante 3: choose your main hand and start buying the right Planet Cards.
- Antes 4-5: keep money high, replace weak Jokers and watch Boss Blinds.
- Antes 6-7: look for xMult or another effect that raises late scoring.
- Ante 8: stop changing plans without a strong reason and reinforce what works.

The official Balatro site describes the game as a poker roguelike built around Jokers and combos. The Steam page lists tools such as Jokers, Tarot Cards, Planet Cards, Spectral Cards, Vouchers and multiple decks. To check platforms and official updates, use [the official Balatro site](https://www.playbalatro.com/) and [the official Steam page](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379780/Balatro/).

## Frequently Asked Questions

What hand should beginners play first in Balatro?

Pair, Two Pair and Full House are the most stable early choices. They need fewer discards than forced Straights or Flushes.

Should I buy every rare Joker?

No. A rare Joker that does not fit your hand is worse than a common Joker that triggers often.

When should I use discards?

Use discards to complete realistic hands. Do not spend all of them chasing perfection when an average hand beats the Blind.

How much money should I keep in the shop?

Once your score is stable, try to stay near 25 dollars. Interest can then fund later rerolls and purchases.

Are Planet Cards always worth buying?

They are worth it when they upgrade the hand you already play often. Otherwise they split your build.

What is the biggest beginner mistake against Boss Blinds?

Starting too fast without reading the boss effect. Always check whether your suit, hand size or main card type is punished.

When should I reroll the shop?

Reroll only after you have a basic scoring engine or enough money. Early rerolls can delay the Joker you actually need.

Where can I follow official Balatro updates?

Use [the official site](https://www.playbalatro.com/), [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379780/Balatro/) and [Nintendo’s store page](https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/balatro-switch/) for official platform and update information.
